points.description: States that there is no gap (no potential difference) between terminal 4 and the positive terminal, so the voltmeter reads 0. Equivalent wording, such as the two points being the same point or connected with no component between them, earns the mark.

rubric.notes: Full mark for stating that there is no gap between terminal 4 and the positive terminal, in any equivalent wording. No partial credit, since the answer is a single idea. An answer that only says the reading is 0 without giving the reason earns no mark.
